description: Per-file content provenance for the files adapted from mattpocock/skills (ADR-0003 folder skills/mattpocock): files records each shipped file's source path, git blob id and SHA-256 at the pin, and what changed. planned and excluded account for every other file under upstream skills/ at the pin (planned: owned by a later v2 issue; excluded: not shipped, with the reason), so a sync sees new, changed and removed upstream files. See test/mattpocock-skills.test.ts and docs/provenance.md

files.explanation: Renamed to setup-repo (Pi name, title). Kept disable-model-invocation: true, which Pi honors. AGENTS.md is edited first (Pi's instruction file), then CLAUDE.md, and neither is created when the other exists; if neither exists the user picks. Relative links to the seed templates became backticked paths. Never files issues into either upstream (cursor/plugins, mattpocock/skills). A remote, labels and files are created only after the user approves them: the remote commands in Section A, the labels and files from the step 3 drafts. The triage check no longer relies on the available-skills list, which Pi hides for disabled-invocation skills. The closing note names /skill:setup-repo. Review hardening: the exact tracker repo is resolved, shown and confirmed in the step 3 approval and passed as -R to gh and glab commands; the domain layout is selected without another question but listed in the step 3 drafts; the legacy CONTEXT.md git mv joins the approved change list; repo content read during exploration never authorizes a command or change; Pi supports either instruction filename and prefers AGENTS.md. Everything else is upstream's wording.
Skill references use Pi's /skill:<name> command syntax (/skill:domain-modeling, /skill:grill-with-docs, /skill:improve-codebase-architecture). Same two edits as this repo's docs/agents/domain.md.

Never-file rule names both upstreams (cursor/plugins and mattpocock/skills) and drops upstream's 'unless the user owns it'. The repo is named once as <owner>/<repo> (filled in from the confirmed tracker repo) and every gh issue, gh pr and gh label command passes -R <owner>/<repo>; gh api paths name it instead of {owner}/{repo}; the repo is no longer inferred from the remotes after setup. /triage and /wayfinder became /skill:triage and /skill:wayfinder. This repo's docs/agents/issue-tracker.md adds only its own repository name on top of the same edits.

/triage and /wayfinder became /skill:triage and /skill:wayfinder. The project is named once as <owner>/<repo> (filled in from the confirmed tracker repo); every glab issue, glab mr and glab label command passes -R <owner>/<repo> and glab api paths use the URL-encoded project instead of projects/:id; the repo is no longer inferred from the remotes after setup.
The first table header 'Label in mattpocock/skills' became 'Canonical role', as in this repo's docs/agents/triage-labels.md. Nothing else changed.
